decisionConsequence: The reused carrier is mechanically valid but does not support the current T05 product thesis: room 2 is excessively narrow under the declared motor-noise model, room 3 does not realize a meaningful fast/safe completion-time tradeoff, and bounded synthetic learning does not improve enough. T05 is demoted for this G0 decision without retuning the carrier.
boundary: This does not reject precision-movement games generally and does not estimate Human flow or enjoyment.
